assessment_objectives.objective: a classification scheme exists to determine confidentiality shelf-life.

the shelf-life classification is used as a direct input to Post-Quantum Cryptography (PQC) migration prioritization, including prioritizing data with a shelf-life exceeding the expected PQC arrival horizon.
assessment_objectives.scf_defined_parameters: at least 10 years, or the transition horizon published by the applicable national cryptographic authority where one exists
